1.w: [“] Behold, My Servant, I take hold of him, My Chosen One, [in whom] My soul delights; I have put My Spirit upon Him, and He will bring forth justice to the nations.

2.w: He will not cry out, and He will not lift up, and He will not make heard His voice in the street.

3.w: A bruised reed He will not break, and smoldering flax He will not quench; for [in] faithfulness He will bring forth justice.

4.w: He will not be dimmed and not be crushed, until He has established justice on the earth, and in His law the islands will put their hope.”

5.w: Thus says God YHWH, the One creating the heavens and stretching them out, spreading out the earth and its offspring, giving breath to the people on it and spirit to those walking on it:

6.w: “I, YHWH, have called You in righteousness, and have taken hold of your hand, and watched over you and given you as a covenant to the people, as a light to the nations—

7.w: to open eyes of the blind, to bring out the prisoner from the dungeon, [and] from the house of confinement those sitting in darkness.

8.w: I [am] YHWH—that [is] My name! And My glory I will not give to another, or My praise to the idols.

9.w: Behold, the former things, they have come, and new [things] I am declaring—before they spring forth, I proclaim [them] to you⁺.”

10.w: Sing to YHWH a new song, His praise from the end of the earth—those going down [to] the sea, and all that is in it; the islands, and those dwelling in them.

11.w: Let the wilderness and its cities lift up, the villages [where] Kedar dwells; let those dwelling in Sela sing; let them shout from the top of the mountains.

12.w: Let them give glory to YHWH and declare His praise in the islands.

13.w: YHWH goes forth like a mighty one; like a man of war He stirs up zeal. He shouts, yes, He roars; over His enemies He will prevail.

14.w: “I have been silent from ages past; I have been still and restrained Myself; like a woman in labor I will groan; I will gasp and pant at once.

15.w: I will lay waste the mountains and hills, and all their vegetation I will dry up; and I will turn the rivers into islands, and the pools I will dry up.

16.w: And the blind I will bring by a way they did not know; I will lead them by paths they have not known; I will turn the darkness before their faces into light, and the crooked places into level ground. These [are] the things I will do for them and I will not forsake them.

17.w: They will be turned back, they are utterly put to shame—those trusting in the idols, those saying to molten images, ‘You⁺ [are] are our gods.’

18.w: Listen, O deaf ones, and look O blind ones, in order to see.

19.w: Who [is] blind, but for My servant, or deaf like My messenger I am sending? Who [is] blind like Meshullam or blind like the servant of YHWH?

20.w: Seeing many things, you do not keep watch; opening the ears, and he does not hear.”

21.w: YHWH delights on account of His righteousness, to magnify the law and make it glorious.

22.w: And it [is] a people robbed and plundered; all of them are trapped in holes, or hidden in houses of prisoners. They have become a spoil with no rescue, a plunder and no one is saying, “Send [them] back!”

23.w: Who among you⁺ will give ear to this? [Who] will listen and obey hereafter?

24.w: Who gave Jacob as plunder and Israel to those plundering? Was it not YHWH, against whom we have sinned? And they were not willing to walk in His ways, and they would not obey His law.

25.w: And He poured out on him the heat of His nose and the fierceness of battle; and it has set him on fire all around, and he did not know [it], and it burned him, and he did not set [it] upon [his] heart.
